'''Mendao''' was a warrior from [[Shienar]]. 

== Activities ==
He was one of the twenty Shienarans picked to accompany [[Ingtar Shinowa]] and [[Rand al'Thor]] on the hunt for the [[Horn of Valere]].

He wintered in the [[Mountains of Mist]] with [[Perrin]] and Rand; After [[Moiraine]] sent him and the other Shienaran soldiers to [[Jehannah]], he was killed in a duel with three Hunters for the Horn.{{ref|{{c|Mendao}}}}{{ref/book|5|40}}
